items.headline: Purdie, placekicker Reeves lead Liberty rally past New Mexico State 30-14
items.description: — Deshawan Purdie threw for 252 yards and a touchdown and Kam Davis ran for a touchdown and Liberty beat New Mexico State 30-14 on Saturday.

items.headline: Creel's career-high 211 yards rushing, TD lead Jacksonville State's route of New Mexico State 24-0
items.description: — Quarterback Caden Creel rushed for a career-high 211 yards and a touchdown as Jacksonville State shut out New Mexico State 24-0 on Wednesday night.
